title: Punk Girl with Spray Can
description: A young woman with pale skin and spiky black hair stands in a dynamic pose against a plain gray background. She wears a red leather jacket, black pants with straps, red boots, and a red bandana, holding a spray can emitting red mist in one hand and a large ornate knife in the other.
prompt: A fierce young woman with spiky black hair and red bandana, wearing an open red leather jacket over a black mesh top, black tactical pants, and red combat boots. She has pale skin and yellow eyes, dynamically posed with one leg raised, holding a red spray can emitting mist in her left hand and a large silver knife in her right. Comic book style, strong outlines, dramatic lighting, plain gray background.
